Non-slip hangers: compare garment support and the useful pack size

Match the hanger to the clothing

Slim flocked hangers can help keep some garments in place, but shoulder shape, width and intended load still matter. A trouser bar, skirt clips and a contoured jacket hanger serve different jobs. Do not assume that every non-slip finish suits delicate or damp clothing. Check the garment-care advice and the hanger maker's instructions instead of choosing only by the number in the pack.

Count useful hangers rather than the largest bundle

Work out how many matching hangers you need and whether their width suits the rail depth. Illustrative figures: 50 at £20 is 40p each, while 10 at £6 is 60p each; the bigger pack is cheaper per hanger only if the extra pieces are useful. These are arithmetic examples, not live prices. Check whether selected variants change the pack quantity and whether hooks or clips add bulk to a crowded wardrobe.
